evidence_level: Static source inspection only; no model inference, latency, bandwidth, energy or thermal measurements.

entrypoints.observation: Write entry: infer=True retrieves existing memories before the single extraction LLM call, then batch-embeds facts and persists them; infer=False bypasses extraction.
Read entry: embeds query, performs semantic and supported keyword lookup, computes entity boosts, and ranks candidates. Costs depend on configured providers and scope.
Configurable LLM, embedder, vector store and optional reranker; the package name does not pin a model or deployment.
Local MemFS context compilation reads committed Markdown from Git HEAD. This is a versioned filesystem path, not automatically an ANN workload.
Post-turn memory synchronization; remote sync and local work need separate timing boundaries.
Adds a note through conditional evolution and Chroma storage; entry skips LLM evolution when no existing neighbors are available.
Neighbor retrieval precedes an LLM evolution decision; link and neighbor updates depend on its output.
Loops over all stored notes and calls add_document; actual embedding and storage work must be traced before attributing any amplification.
Configures SentenceTransformerEmbeddingFunction, default all-MiniLM-L6-v2, and ChromaDB document/query operations.
Paper evaluation has its own implementation, separate from the reusable A-mem package.

official_references.observation: Current runtime is letta-ai/letta-code; retired V1 server is on archive branch.
Current MemFS is Git-backed; semantic/vector indexing is optional.
Mem0 is an application memory layer; app calls search before a model call and add after a useful interaction. Current inferred writes are additive; explicit update/delete are separate.
Publication metadata verified; complete paper and official artifact not obtained in this inspection. No performance claims imported.

hypotheses_not_results: Foreground reasoning and background memory maintenance may contend for shared LLM serving resources under concurrency.
Different memory implementations may create distinct query, mutation, context-compilation and persistence costs; no shared memory-bound classification is assumed.
Hybrid bonding is relevant only if a measured hot working set and a 2D bandwidth/energy bottleneck fit its capacity, area, power and thermal constraints.

workload_contract: Pin source and model revisions, tokenizer, precision, inference engine, embedding provider and database configuration.
Use a self-hosted memory backend and the same agent reasoning harness for end-to-end comparisons.
Preserve chronological memory causality and per-user/session isolation; concurrent independent sessions are permitted.
Measure foreground retrieval/TTFT/turn latency and background memory freshness, queue growth and throughput together.
trace_fields: LLM role, prompt/output tokens and actual batch/shape
database candidates, filters, index bytes and working-set residency
CPU/GPU execution and measured DRAM/HBM/PCIe/SSD traffic
background update completion and memory version visible to each read
baseline: CPU plus optimized GPU inference and an appropriately configured database.
Tune batching, asynchronous writes, inference scheduling and available prompt/prefix caching before crediting hardware gains.
Compare equal task quality, retrieval quality, memory freshness and hardware/resource budget.
architecture_gate: Locate a material end-to-end bottleneck under realistic memory sizes and offered load.
Demonstrate resource asymmetry and a physical limitation that software tuning and fair 2D baselines do not remove.
Validate gains after data movement, queueing, area, energy and thermal costs, including held-out workloads.
